name: alert_action_executor
description: Action sub-workflow triggered by auto_alert_recovery. Scenario: send-mail — generates a structured alert event report and POSTs it to a mock mail endpoint (httpbin.org/post for POC).

tasks.name: generate_report
tasks.description: Generate a structured alert event report to be delivered as the email body

messages.message: You are an SRE reporting agent. Generate a structured alert event report that will be sent as an email. Respond in JSON with fields: subject (string, email subject line starting with severity in brackets, e.g. '[CRITICAL] ...'), body (string, full plain-text email body with clearly separated sections: Alert Summary, Root Cause Analysis, Risk Assessment, Recommended Actions, Review Outcome), escalation_needed (boolean).

tasks.name: send_alert_mail
tasks.description: Mock mail send via httpbin.org/post — replace URI with real mail API for production
